name: 鈴鈴清潔車

name: 小紅賽車
desc: a cute claymation bright red race car with the number 2 in a white circle, a white racing stripe down the middle, blue and yellow accents, big round eyes and a cheerful smile FACE LAYOUT (canonical, match the reference portrait): big round eyes with black pupils and a highlight sit ON THE WINDSHIELD panel; small round yellow headlights sit separately on the front nose and are NOT the eyes — both must be present at once; a soft smile line runs low across the front bumper, below the headlights. Self-identifying features that must all be present: a rounded, tall, chubby super-deformed toy-car silhouette (NOT a low-slung streamlined sports car); the number 2 in a white circle on the side door; a white racing stripe down the middle of the hood; a single rear spoiler; blue accents on the bumper and trim; no roof antenna. Do NOT draw: eyes on the headlights, headlights used as eyes, missing headlights, roof antenna, star antenna, yellow racing stripe, the number 95, lightning bolt decal, sponsor decals, low-slung streamlined sports car body, wide flat rally or off-road stance, oversized wheels, mouth built into the radiator grille, Pixar Cars, Lightning McQueen, any car that reads at a glance as a Disney/Pixar Cars character. The silhouette alone must read as this original character and clearly not as Lightning McQueen.

name: 紅爸
desc: a cute claymation adult bright red race car named Hongba (紅爸), dad of Xiao Hong (小紅賽車), slightly larger rounded red body, white racing stripe down the middle of the hood, white circle with a blue number 1 on the door (not 2), blue windshield frame, blue side mirrors, blue rear spoiler, blue wheel rims with yellow hubs. FACE LAYOUT (important): big warm round black eyes ONLY on the windshield; yellow round headlights sit on the front beside the nose and are NOT the eyes; the MOUTH is on the lower front bumper, and a playful curly black handlebar mustache sits directly ABOVE that mouth on the front of the car — mustache and mouth are on the car front nose/bumper, NOT floating on the windshield. Soft friendly dad smile under the curled-up mustache tips (俏皮翹鬍子). Soft hand-sculpted clay texture. No arms, no hands, no human limbs. Same family look as red race car number 2 but clearly an adult father car

name: 小紅賽車年幼版

FACE LAYOUT (critical, copy reference baby): large round white eyes with black pupils sit on the UPPER FRONT FACE / windshield face plane (same layout as the mustache dad beside it) — eyes are NOT headlights on the bumper. Directly BELOW the eyes: a teal-blue vanilla pacifier (青綠香草奶嘴) in the mouth/grille, with a ring handle. Two small bright yellow round cheek spots beside the pacifier. Compact stubby mini race-car body, pebbled/honeycomb clay texture matching the hero, dark-blue side/top window clay, tiny black wheels, no racing number. Same family look as the hero baby — NOT a bubble car with eyes on the bumper, NOT the adult dad

name: 小紅賽車的爸爸年輕版
desc: a cute claymation younger dad bright red race car — EXACTLY the large foreground father car from the ep-24 hero (小紅賽車的爸爸年輕版). FACE LAYOUT (critical, copy reference dad 1:1): front-facing (not long side-profile race car); large round white eyes with black pupils on the UPPER FRONT FACE; thick arched black eyebrows above the eyes on a small blue clay window band; prominent playful black curly handlebar mustache (俏皮翹鬍子) centered BELOW the eyes on the red front face; simple curved black smile under the mustache; two bright yellow round cheek/headlight dots beside the mustache. Compact rounded red clay body with pebbled/honeycomb texture matching the hero, blue side windows, small red round side mirrors, chunky black wheels with light hubs. NO long sports-car profile, NO grey bumper bar, NO door number badge required. Single character — NOT the tiny pacifier baby on the roof
